name: Monster Energy
verdict: Monster Energy is a brand of Monster Beverage Corporation (Nasdaq: MNST); its largest disclosed holder is The Coca-Cola Company at about 20.9%, a company, not a state. Nothing found.
note: McLaren Official Partner from the 2024 season (announced November 2023); also title sponsor of Monster Energy Yamaha MotoGP since 2019, confirmed for 2026 at the Jakarta launch (Yamaha Motor race release, 2026-01-22). Monster Energy is the brand of Monster Beverage Corporation (Nasdaq: MNST); Coca-Cola held about 20.9% as of 13 Feb 2026 per the FY2025 10-K. No state or fund owner.
